title: Check If It Is a Straight Line
statement:
You are given an array `coordinates`, where `coordinates[i] = [x, y]` represents the coordinate of a point.
Check if these points make a straight line in the XY plane.
Print `YES` if they do, otherwise `NO`.
inputFormat:
Line 1: an integer N (number of points).
Next N lines: two space-separated integers x and y.
constraints:
2 <= coordinates.length <= 1000
coordinates[i].length == 2
-10^4 <= coordinates[i][0], coordinates[i][1] <= 10^4
Coordinates contain no duplicate point.

examples.explanation: Points lie on the line y = x + 1.
The point (3,4) breaks the straight line.

n = int(input())
coords = [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(n)]
